role: Fires each server's scheduled restarts and backups at wall-clock time, through the watchdog.

fields.label: KGSM executable
fields.description: Path to the KGSM executable, which the scheduler reads each server's schedule from. It is checked at startup, and the daemon refuses to run if nothing is there.

fields.label: Watchdog control socket
fields.description: The watchdog's control socket, which every scheduled restart is issued through. It has to match the path the watchdog listens on, or nothing scheduled ever fires.

fields.label: Status socket
fields.description: Unix socket the scheduler serves its schedule snapshot on. The Control Panel reads it here to show what is scheduled and when it last ran.

fields.label: Schedule re-scan interval
fields.description: How often each server's schedule is re-read from KGSM. This bounds how quickly a schedule change takes effect; it does not affect the accuracy of a fire that is already scheduled.

fields.label: Missed-fire grace window
fields.description: How late a missed restart may be and still run. Anything later is skipped, so a host that was down does not come back to a burst of catch-up restarts. Zero always runs missed restarts.
